sources.note: Nothing on Toromona stress. Sec. 2 (preprint p. 3): Toromona is one of Girard's (1971) nomina nuda; 'the only linguistic data that exist on Toromona.. is a list of 97 words collected by.. Marius Del Castillo published in Del Castillo (1929: 122-123)'; Del Castillo said they spoke almost the same language as the Araona, 66% (64/97) of the words near-identical to Pitman's (1981) Araona dictionary (Guillaume 2011a). The chapter's phonology section covers the five living Takanan languages only.
